name: microgrid-iq-calculator
description: Read-only electrical, energy, utility, battery, dwelling-load, and cash-flow calculators with structured assumptions and warnings.

interface.longDescription: Run focused, stateless calculations for energy use, AC power, voltage drop, dwelling service load, flat-rate utility bills, battery backup capacity, and project cash-flow metrics. Results include units, stated assumptions, method version, and safety limitations.
defaultPrompt: Calculate energy use for a 5 kW load running 8 hours.
Estimate voltage drop for my copper circuit.
Size a battery for 2 kW of critical load for 12 hours.
